name: LateCraft Survival 0.14.X #1 3/75
description:
LateCraft is a server created in 31.05.2020 by player Lituty. Currently, the available modes are Anarchy, Survival, and Mini-Games.

Anarchy has a different port (19180) than the Survival server (19150).

Currently, all available mini-games are:

BedWars, SkyWars, Spleef, and Cave.

The available main warps are /warp pvp and /warp mine.

Currently, the server is administered by two players:

Lituty - Server Owner (main server file and security manager)

ZaSto (formerly Filip_Games) - Lower file manager, server administrator, and head of server moderators. (Written by this post)
